parameters.description: The IPv6 address allocated to the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: BusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The business status of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values:

- **Normal**: normal.

- **FinancialLocked**: locked.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing transform type of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values:

- **Prepay**: subscription.

- **Postpay**: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description: The specification of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values: **small**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values:

- **init**: initializing.

- **provisioning**: being provisioned.

- **active**: available.

- **updating**: being updated.

- **upgrading**: being upgraded.

- **deleting**: being deleted.

- **deleted**: deleted.
